item.vision_goggles.tactical_manual.tool: Right-click to open the Vision Goggles 2.0.0 Field Guide
gui.vision_goggles.manual.goggles.nvg.de: Amplifies darkness without potion icons. Shorts out after 2s underwater.
gui.vision_goggles.manual.goggles.therma: Highlights warm mobs & heat blocks; Vanilla armor insulates. Fails in water.
gui.vision_goggles.manual.goggles.bio.de: Amber organic spectrum for tracking living targets and vital signatures.
Usuwa mgłę podwodną, podwaja tlen (rebreather 2x O2), daje +20% pływania i szybkie kopanie pod wodą.
gui.vision_goggles.manual.goggles.modula: Customizable Tri-Lens chassis supporting optics, utility, and Lua chips.
gui.vision_goggles.manual.goggles.pro.de: Reinforced obsidian chassis with higher module capacity and battery scaling.
gui.vision_goggles.manual.mod.nvg.title: Night Vision Module
gui.vision_goggles.manual.mod.nvg.desc: Adds NVG phosphor vision with P43 persistence and solar/flash glare.
gui.vision_goggles.manual.mod.thermal.de: Adds FLIR entity heat mask, Ironbow palette, and heat/cold block contrast.
gui.vision_goggles.manual.mod.bio.title: Biometric Module
gui.vision_goggles.manual.mod.bio.desc: Enables Biometric spectrum to highlight living health and threat contrast.

gui.vision_goggles.manual.mod.battery.de: Increases maximum goggle battery capacity for longer field deployments.

gui.vision_goggles.manual.mod.env.title: Environment Module
gui.vision_goggles.manual.mod.env.desc: Tracks remaining underwater oxygen seconds and warns below 20% air.
gui.vision_goggles.manual.mod.flashlight: Mounts a tactical beam pod on Modular Goggles; works independently.
gui.vision_goggles.manual.mod.lua.title: Programmable Module (Lua)

Tight long-range tactical spot beam with strong NVG glare against foes.
gui.vision_goggles.manual.flash.wide_clo: Wide covers open rooms; Close delivers intense short-range floodlight.
gui.vision_goggles.manual.flash.strobe.d: Slows hostiles (Slowness II), halts Creepers (24m), and pulses NVG glare.
gui.vision_goggles.manual.station.assemb: All goggles & flashlights are assembled here using TEMS components.
gui.vision_goggles.manual.station.repair: Install/extract modules safely; repair with Electrical Parts or Frame.
